article.story: UTSA (6-1) at Tulane (3-3), Oct. 24 at 8 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: UTSA by 4. Against the spread: UTSA 4-3, Tulane 3-3. How to watch: ESPNU Key stats UTSA Offense Overall: 411.1 yards per game (55th in FBS) Passing: 231.7 yards per game (68th) Rushing: 179.4 yards per game (49th) Scoring: 32.3 points per game (49th) UTSA Defense Overall: 400.0 yards per game (112th in FBS) Passing: 200.1 yards per game (57th) Rushing: 199.9 yards per game (128th) Scoring: 27.0 points per game (100th) Tulane Offense Overall: 332.0 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 179.7 yards per game (116th) Rushing: 152.3 yards per game (76th) Scoring: 20.5 points per game (117th) Tulane Defense Overall: 420.7 yards per game (124th in FBS) Passing: 208.2 yards per game (67th) Rushing: 212.5 yards per game (133rd) Scoring: 21.7 points per game (50th) Tulane ranks 124th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 45.6% of third downs. UTSA is 22nd in the FBS with a +4 turnover margin. UTSA ranks 134th in the FBS averaging 83.9 penalty yards per game, compared to Tulane's 57th-ranked 54.0 per-game average. Tulane is 5th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 65.4% of trips. Tulane is last the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:20. Team leaders UTSA Passing: Owen McCown, 1,578 yards, 10 TDs, 2 INTs, 69.5 completion percentage Rushing: Will Henderson III, 562 yards on 94 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: D.J. Allen, 325 yards on 24 catches, 2 TDs Tulane Passing: Kadin Semonza, 804 yards, 4 TDs, 2 INTs, 53.8 completion percentage Rushing: Maurice Turner, 315 yards on 37 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Destyn Hill, 285 yards on 21 catches, 2 TDs Last game UTSA defeated Navy 38-34 on Oct. 17. McCown threw for 359 yards on 28-of-38 attempts (73.7%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. Henderson had 78 rushing yards on 16 carries and one touchdown, adding three receptions for eight yards. David Amador II put up 71 yards on seven catches. Tulane defeated Memphis 31-17 on Oct. 16. Trace Johnson led Tulane with 165 yards on 11-of-21 passing (52.4%) for one touchdown and one interception. Johnnie Daniels carried the ball seven times for 55 yards and scored one touchdown. Hill had four receptions for 62 yards and one touchdown. Next game UTSA plays at Florida Atlantic on Nov. 5. Tulane plays at Charlotte on Oct. 30.
